mapper.sql: r.result = 'success' AND r.environment = 'production' AND r.operation <> 'rollback' AND r.coverage = 'full'

AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM version_release rr JOIN version_release_item ri ON ri.workspace_id = rr.workspace_id AND ri.release_id = rr.id WHERE rr.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND rr.result = 'success' AND rr.environment = 'production' AND rr.operation = 'rollback' AND rr.related_release_id = r.id AND rr.occurred_at > r.occurred_at AND ri.task_id = i.task_id)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM demand d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.created_at >= #{from} AND d.created_at < #{before}

SELECT l.action AS `key`, COUNT(DISTINCT l.demand_id) AS count FROM demand_log l JOIN demand d ON d.id = l.demand_id AND d.workspace_id = l.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.created_at >= #{from} AND l.created_at < #{before} AND l.action IN ('pass', 'plan', 'complete')
GROUP BY l.action

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.demand_id) FROM demand_log l JOIN demand d ON d.id = l.demand_id AND d.workspace_id = l.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.created_at >= #{from} AND l.created_at < #{before} AND (l.action = 'rej' OR (l.action = 'cancel' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.change_data, '$.after.closeReason')) = 'dup'))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.demand_id) FROM demand_log l JOIN demand d ON d.id = l.demand_id AND d.workspace_id = l.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.created_at >= #{from} AND l.created_at < #{before} AND l.action = 'cancel' AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.change_data, '$.after.closeReason')), 'cancel') = 'cancel'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.demand_id) FROM version_release r JOIN version_release_item i ON i.release_id = r.id AND i.workspace_id = r.workspace_id WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND AND r.occurred_at >= #{from} AND r.occurred_at < #{before} AND i.disposition = 'published' AND i.demand_id IS NOT NULL AND r.req_id = #{reqId}

SELECT t.item_type AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.created_at >= #{from} AND t.created_at < #{before}
GROUP BY t.item_type

SELECT t.item_type AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column = 'done' AND t.completed_at >= #{from} AND t.completed_at < #{before} AND t.canceled_at IS NULL
GROUP BY t.item_type
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.canceled_at >= #{from} AND t.canceled_at < #{before} AND t.completed_at IS NULL
mapper.sql: SELECT l.task_id FROM task_log l JOIN task t ON t.id = l.task_id AND t.workspace_id = l.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.action = 'move' AND l.from_column = 'backlog' AND l.to_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND l.created_at >= #{from} AND l.created_at < #{before} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT t.id FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.test_requested_at >= #{from} AND t.test_requested_at < #{before}
SELECT t.id FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.test_started_at >= #{from} AND t.test_started_at < #{before}

UNION

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.item_type = 'bug' AND t.created_at >= #{from} AND t.created_at < #{before}

SELECT d.status AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS count FROM demand d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
GROUP BY d.status

SELECT CASE WHEN t.board_column = 'backlog' THEN 'backlog' WHEN t.board_column = 'test' OR bc.name = '待测试' THEN 'test' WHEN t.board_column = 'testing' OR bc.name = '测试中' THEN 'testing' WHEN t.test_finished_at IS NULL AND t.test_started_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'testing' WHEN t.test_finished_at IS NULL AND t.test_requested_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'test' ELSE 'doing' END AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task t LEFT JOIN board_column bc ON bc.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND bc.id = t.board_column WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled')
GROUP BY CASE WHEN t.board_column = 'backlog' THEN 'backlog' WHEN t.board_column = 'test' OR bc.name = '待测试' THEN 'test' WHEN t.board_column = 'testing' OR bc.name = '测试中' THEN 'testing' WHEN t.test_finished_at IS NULL AND t.test_started_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'testing' WHEN t.test_finished_at IS NULL AND t.test_requested_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'test' ELSE 'doing' END

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column = 'done' AND t.completed_at >= #{from} AND t.completed_at < #{before} AND t.canceled_at IS NULL
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND t.due_date >= #{from} AND t.due_date <= #{to}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(t.completed_at) <= t.due_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS onTime, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(t.completed_at) > t.due_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS late, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.completed_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS openCount FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.canceled_at IS NULL AND t.due_date >= #{from} AND t.due_date <= #{to}

SELECT t.id, 'task' AS kind, t.item_type AS type, t.title, r.name AS projectName, t.owner AS person, CAST(t.due_date AS DATETIME) AS at, CASE t.board_column WHEN 'backlog' THEN '待处理' WHEN 'doing' THEN '进行中' WHEN 'test' THEN '待测试' WHEN 'testing' THEN '测试中' ELSE t.board_column END AS extra FROM task t LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND t.due_date >= #{from} AND t.due_date <= #{to}
ORDER BY t.due_date, t.priority, BINARY t.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND t.priority = 'P0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND t.updated_at < #{staleBefore}

SELECT r.id, r.project_name AS projectName, r.version_name AS versionName, r.occurred_at AS at, r.executor_name AS executor, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.demand_id) FROM version_release_item i WHERE i.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND i.release_id = r.id AND i.disposition = 'published' AND i.demand_id IS NOT NULL) AS demands, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM version_release_item i WHERE i.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND i.release_id = r.id AND i.disposition = 'published') AS tasks, r.notes AS note FROM version_release r WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND AND r.occurred_at >= #{from} AND r.occurred_at < #{before} AND r.req_id = #{reqId} ORDER BY r.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT p.id, CONCAT('发布计划 ', COALESCE(CONCAT('PL-', LPAD(p.plan_no, 3, '0')), '')) AS name, p.status, v.name AS versionName, p.planned_at AS plannedAt FROM version_release_plan p LEFT JOIN project_version v ON v.id = p.version_id AND v.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.planned_at >= #{from} AND p.planned_at < #{before} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM version_release_plan_version pv WHERE pv.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND pv.plan_id = p.id AND pv.req_id = #{reqId})
ORDER BY p.planned_at DESC

SELECT t.id AS taskId, t.title, t.item_type AS type, r.name AS projectName, dd.title AS demandTitle, t.completed_at AS at, t.due_date AS dueDate, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(tl.minutes) FROM time_log tl WHERE tl.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tl.task_id = t.id), 0) AS minutes, CASE WHEN cr.first_started_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0, DATEDIFF(t.completed_at, cr.first_started_at)) END AS durationDays, CASE WHEN t.due_date IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN DATE(t.completed_at) <= t.due_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS onTime, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM version_release_item i JOIN version_release rr ON rr.id = i.release_id AND rr.workspace_id = i.workspace_id WHERE i.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND i.task_id = t.id AND i.disposition = 'published' AND rr.result = 'success' AND rr.environment = 'production' AND rr.operation <> 'rollback' AND rr.coverage = 'full' AND rr.occurred_at >= #{from} AND rr.occurred_at < #{before} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS released FROM task t LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id LEFT JOIN demand dd ON dd.id = t.demand_id AND dd.workspace_id = t.workspace_id LEFT JOIN task_completion_record cr ON cr.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND cr.task_id = t.id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column = 'done' AND t.completed_at >= #{from} AND t.completed_at < #{before} AND t.canceled_at IS NULL
ORDER BY t.completed_at DESC, BINARY t.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(t.completed_at) <= t.due_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS value FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column = 'done' AND t.completed_at >= #{from} AND t.completed_at < #{before} AND t.canceled_at IS NULL AND t.due_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column = 'done' AND t.completed_at >= #{from} AND t.completed_at < #{before} AND t.canceled_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM version_release_item i JOIN version_release rr ON rr.id = i.release_id AND rr.workspace_id = i.workspace_id WHERE i.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND i.task_id = t.id AND i.disposition = 'published' AND rr.result = 'success' AND rr.environment = 'production' AND rr.operation <> 'rollback' AND rr.coverage = 'full' AND rr.occurred_at >= #{from} AND rr.occurred_at < #{before})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND t.test_finished_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT pv.req_id AS projectId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM version_release_plan p JOIN version_release_plan_version pv ON pv.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND pv.plan_id = p.id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.status = 'ready' AND p.planned_at IS NOT NULL AND p.planned_at < #{now} GROUP BY pv.req_id
SELECT d.req_id AS projectId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM demand d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.status IN ('review', 'pass') GROUP BY d.req_id

SELECT l.actor_id AS userId, COALESCE(u.display_name, u.username, l.actor_id) AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.task_id) AS count FROM task_log l JOIN task t ON t.id = l.task_id AND t.workspace_id = l.workspace_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = l.actor_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.action = 'create' AND l.created_at >= #{from} AND l.created_at < #{before} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY l.actor_id, u.display_name, u.username

SELECT x.owner_user_id AS userId, COUNT(DISTINCT x.task_id) AS count FROM ( SELECT t.owner_user_id, l.task_id FROM task_log l JOIN task t ON t.id = l.task_id AND t.workspace_id = l.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.action = 'move' AND l.from_column = 'backlog' AND l.to_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND l.created_at >= #{from} AND l.created_at < #{before} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT t.owner_user_id, t.id FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.test_requested_at >= #{from} AND t.test_requested_at < #{before} AND t.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT t.owner_user_id, t.id FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.test_started_at >= #{from} AND t.test_started_at < #{before} AND t.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
) x GROUP BY x.owner_user_id

SELECT t.owner_user_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column = 'done' AND t.completed_at >= #{from} AND t.completed_at < #{before} AND t.canceled_at IS NULL AND t.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.owner_user_id

SELECT t.owner_user_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND t.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.owner_user_id

SELECT t.owner_user_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND t.due_date IS NOT NULL AND t.due_date < #{today} AND t.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.owner_user_id

SELECT t.owner_user_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND t.is_blocked = 1 AND t.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.owner_user_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND t.due_date IS NOT NULL AND t.due_date < #{today}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND t.is_blocked = 1

SELECT l.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(SUM(l.minutes), 0) AS count FROM time_log l JOIN task t ON t.id = l.task_id AND t.workspace_id = l.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.started_at >= #{from} AND l.started_at < #{before} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY l.user_id

SELECT l.user_id AS userId, t.req_id AS projectId, r.name AS projectName, COALESCE(SUM(l.minutes), 0) AS count FROM time_log l JOIN task t ON t.id = l.task_id AND t.workspace_id = l.workspace_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.started_at >= #{from} AND l.started_at < #{before} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY l.user_id, t.req_id, r.name

SELECT h.saved_by_user_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM requirement_doc_history h JOIN requirement_doc d ON d.id = h.doc_id AND d.workspace_id = h.workspace_id WHERE h.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND h.created_at >= #{from} AND h.created_at < #{before} AND h.saved_by_user_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY h.saved_by_user_id

SELECT r.executed_by_user_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM test_case_run r JOIN test_case c ON c.id = r.case_id AND c.workspace_id = r.workspace_id WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND r.status = 'passed' AND r.created_at >= #{from} AND r.created_at < #{before} AND r.executed_by_user_id IS NOT NULL AND c.req_id = #{reqId} GROUP BY r.executed_by_user_id

SELECT l.actor_id AS userId, COUNT(DISTINCT l.task_id) AS count FROM task_log l JOIN task t ON t.id = l.task_id AND t.workspace_id = l.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.action = 'create' AND t.item_type = 'bug' AND l.created_at >= #{from} AND l.created_at < #{before} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.actor_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY l.actor_id

SELECT t.priority AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.item_type = 'bug' AND t.created_at >= #{from} AND t.created_at < #{before}
GROUP BY t.priority

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.minutes), 0) FROM time_log l JOIN task t ON t.id = l.task_id AND t.workspace_id = l.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.started_at >= #{from} AND l.started_at < #{before} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND (t.test_requested_at IS NOT NULL OR t.test_started_at IS NOT NULL OR t.test_finished_at IS NOT NULL OR t.item_type = 'bug')

SELECT l.operator AS userId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM demand_log l JOIN demand d ON d.id = l.demand_id AND d.workspace_id = l.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.created_at >= #{from} AND l.created_at < #{before} AND l.operator IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY l.operator

SELECT c.author_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task_comment c JOIN task t ON t.id = c.task_id AND t.workspace_id = c.workspace_id WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.created_at >= #{from} AND c.created_at < #{before} AND c.author_id IS NOT NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY c.author_id

SELECT d.req_id AS projectId, r.name AS projectName, l.action AS `key`, COUNT(DISTINCT l.demand_id) AS count FROM demand_log l JOIN demand d ON d.id = l.demand_id AND d.workspace_id = l.workspace_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = d.req_id AND r.workspace_id = d.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.created_at >= #{from} AND l.created_at < #{before} AND l.action IN ('pass', 'plan', 'complete') GROUP BY d.req_id, r.name, l.action

SELECT r.req_id AS projectId, r.project_name AS projectName, COUNT(DISTINCT i.demand_id) AS count FROM version_release r JOIN version_release_item i ON i.release_id = r.id AND i.workspace_id = r.workspace_id WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND AND r.occurred_at >= #{from} AND r.occurred_at < #{before} AND i.disposition = 'published' AND i.demand_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.req_id, r.project_name

SELECT t.req_id AS projectId, r.name AS projectName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task t LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.created_at >= #{from} AND t.created_at < #{before} GROUP BY t.req_id, r.name

SELECT t.req_id AS projectId, r.name AS projectName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task t LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column = 'done' AND t.completed_at >= #{from} AND t.completed_at < #{before} AND t.canceled_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.req_id, r.name

SELECT t.req_id AS projectId, r.name AS projectName, COALESCE(SUM(l.minutes), 0) AS count FROM time_log l JOIN task t ON t.id = l.task_id AND t.workspace_id = l.workspace_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.started_at >= #{from} AND l.started_at < #{before} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.req_id, r.name
SELECT r.id AS projectId, r.name AS projectName, 0 AS count FROM requirement r WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND r.archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.sort_order, r.id

SELECT t.id, 'task' AS kind, t.item_type AS type, t.title, r.name AS projectName, t.owner AS person, CAST(t.due_date AS DATETIME) AS at, CONCAT('逾期 ', DATEDIFF(#{today}, t.due_date), ' 天') AS extra FROM task t LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND t.due_date IS NOT NULL AND t.due_date < #{today}
ORDER BY t.due_date, t.priority, t.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id, 'task' AS kind, t.item_type AS type, t.title, r.name AS projectName, t.owner AS person, t.updated_at AS at, COALESCE(t.blocked_reason, '已阻塞') AS extra FROM task t LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND t.is_blocked = 1
ORDER BY t.updated_at, t.priority, t.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id, 'demand' AS kind, d.item_kind AS type, d.title, r.name AS projectName, COALESCE(u.display_name, u.username, d.created_by) AS person, d.created_at AS at, d.status AS extra FROM demand d LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = d.req_id AND r.workspace_id = d.workspace_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = d.created_by WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.created_at >= #{from} AND d.created_at < #{before}
ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, BINARY d.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id, 'demand' AS kind, d.item_kind AS type, d.title, r.name AS projectName, COALESCE(u.display_name, u.username, l.operator) AS person, l.created_at AS at, COALESCE(l.note, '') AS extra FROM demand_log l JOIN demand d ON d.id = l.demand_id AND d.workspace_id = l.workspace_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = d.req_id AND r.workspace_id = d.workspace_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = l.operator WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.action = #{action} AND l.created_at >= #{from} AND l.created_at < #{before} AND l.id = (SELECT MIN(l2.id) FROM demand_log l2 WHERE l2.workspace_id = l.workspace_id AND l2.demand_id = l.demand_id AND l2.action = l.action AND l2.created_at >= #{from} AND l2.created_at < #{before})
ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id, 'demand' AS kind, d.item_kind AS type, d.title, r.name AS projectName, COALESCE(u.display_name, u.username, l.operator) AS person, l.created_at AS at, CASE WHEN l.action = 'rej' THEN '评审不通过' WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.change_data, '$.after.closeReason')) = 'dup' THEN '重复需求' ELSE '关闭' END AS extra FROM demand_log l JOIN demand d ON d.id = l.demand_id AND d.workspace_id = l.workspace_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = d.req_id AND r.workspace_id = d.workspace_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = l.operator WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.created_at >= #{from} AND l.created_at < #{before} AND (l.action = 'rej' OR (l.action = 'cancel' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.change_data, '$.after.closeReason')) = 'dup')) AND l.id = (SELECT MIN(l2.id) FROM demand_log l2 WHERE l2.workspace_id = l.workspace_id AND l2.demand_id = l.demand_id AND l2.created_at >= #{from} AND l2.created_at < #{before} AND (l2.action = 'rej' OR (l2.action = 'cancel' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l2.change_data, '$.after.closeReason')) = 'dup')))
ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id, 'demand' AS kind, d.item_kind AS type, d.title, r.name AS projectName, COALESCE(u.display_name, u.username, l.operator) AS person, l.created_at AS at, COALESCE(l.note, '中途取消') AS extra FROM demand_log l JOIN demand d ON d.id = l.demand_id AND d.workspace_id = l.workspace_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = d.req_id AND r.workspace_id = d.workspace_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = l.operator WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.action = 'cancel' AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.change_data, '$.after.closeReason')), 'cancel') = 'cancel' AND l.created_at >= #{from} AND l.created_at < #{before} AND l.id = (SELECT MIN(l2.id) FROM demand_log l2 WHERE l2.workspace_id = l.workspace_id AND l2.demand_id = l.demand_id AND l2.created_at >= #{from} AND l2.created_at < #{before} AND l2.action = 'cancel' AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l2.change_data, '$.after.closeReason')), 'cancel') = 'cancel')
ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id, 'demand' AS kind, d.item_kind AS type, d.title, r.project_name AS projectName, d.source AS person, MAX(r.occurred_at) AS at, CONCAT('发布 ', COUNT(DISTINCT r.id), ' 次') AS extra FROM version_release r JOIN version_release_item i ON i.release_id = r.id AND i.workspace_id = r.workspace_id JOIN demand d ON d.id = i.demand_id AND d.workspace_id = r.workspace_id WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND AND r.occurred_at >= #{from} AND r.occurred_at < #{before} AND i.disposition = 'published' AND i.demand_id IS NOT NULL AND r.req_id = #{reqId}
GROUP BY d.id, d.item_kind, d.title, d.source, r.project_name ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id, 'task' AS kind, t.item_type AS type, t.title, r.name AS projectName, t.owner AS person, t.created_at AS at, COALESCE(t.board_column, '') AS extra FROM task t LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.created_at >= #{from} AND t.created_at < #{before}
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, BINARY t.id LIMIT #{limit}

ORDER BY t.test_requested_at DESC, BINARY t.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id, 'task' AS kind, t.item_type AS type, t.title, r.name AS projectName, t.owner AS person, t.test_started_at AS at, '开始测试' AS extra FROM task t LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.test_started_at >= #{from} AND t.test_started_at < #{before}
ORDER BY t.test_started_at DESC, BINARY t.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id, 'task' AS kind, t.item_type AS type, t.title, r.name AS projectName, COALESCE(u.display_name, u.username, l.actor_id) AS person, l.created_at AS at, CONCAT(COALESCE(l.from_column, '—'), ' → ', l.to_column) AS extra FROM task_log l JOIN task t ON t.id = l.task_id AND t.workspace_id = l.workspace_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = l.actor_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.action = 'move' AND l.from_column = 'backlog' AND l.to_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND l.created_at >= #{from} AND l.created_at < #{before} AND l.id = (SELECT MIN(l2.id) FROM task_log l2 WHERE l2.workspace_id = l.workspace_id AND l2.task_id = l.task_id AND l2.action = 'move' AND l2.from_column = 'backlog' AND l2.to_column NOT IN ('done', 'canceled') AND l2.created_at >= #{from} AND l2.created_at < #{before}) AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY l.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, 'task' AS kind, t.item_type AS type, t.title, r.name AS projectName, t.owner AS person, t.completed_at AS at, CASE WHEN t.due_date IS NULL THEN '无截止日期' WHEN DATE(t.completed_at) <= t.due_date THEN '按期' ELSE CONCAT('延期 ', DATEDIFF(t.completed_at, t.due_date), ' 天') END AS extra, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(tl.minutes) FROM time_log tl WHERE tl.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tl.task_id = t.id), 0) AS number FROM task t LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.board_column = 'done' AND t.completed_at >= #{from} AND t.completed_at < #{before} AND t.canceled_at IS NULL AND t.item_type = #{itemType}
ORDER BY t.completed_at DESC, BINARY t.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id, 'task' AS kind, t.item_type AS type, t.title, r.name AS projectName, t.owner AS person, t.canceled_at AS at, COALESCE(t.cancel_reason, '取消') AS extra FROM task t LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.canceled_at >= #{from} AND t.canceled_at < #{before} AND t.completed_at IS NULL
ORDER BY t.canceled_at DESC, BINARY t.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id, 'case' AS kind, 'failed' AS type, c.title, r.name AS projectName, COALESCE(c.latest_by, '未记录') AS person, c.latest_at AS at, COALESCE(c.latest_note, '') AS extra FROM test_case c LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = c.req_id AND r.workspace_id = c.workspace_id WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.latest_status = 'failed' AND c.req_id = #{reqId} ORDER BY c.latest_at DESC, BINARY c.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.id, 'doc' AS kind, d.doc_type AS type, d.title, r.name AS projectName, COALESCE(d.owner, '未记录') AS person, d.updated_at AS at, '草稿' AS extra FROM requirement_doc d LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = d.req_id AND r.workspace_id = d.workspace_id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.status = 'draft' AND d.updated_at < #{before}
ORDER BY d.updated_at, BINARY d.id LIMIT #{limit}
